audit.whatIsWrong: Six places across both layers say Vault (E) blinds you — 'the vault blinds your next Lightslinger autos', 'knock you back and blind your Lightslinger autos', and the whole page is titled around 'Vault (Dash/Blind)'. Vault does not blind.
audit.why: Riot's text: Vault (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 675 range) dashes to an enemy, slows, briefly interrupts, and leaps off to land at max attack range. The vision denial is Blinding Assault (Q, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1025 range) — 'mark an enemy and hinder its vision'. They are two different buttons on two different cooldowns, and the one that turns off Lightslinger is the 1025-range one you can sidestep, not the point-blank dash.
audit.corrected: Vault = knockback plus interrupt; Blinding Assault = the blind. Dodge the Q to keep your autos, count the E to pick your commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was scored Quinn while whys[1] says 'call it even at best'; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were 'Skill' while whys[3] says she pokes you down with no answer and whys[4] says your ult hits nothing.
audit.why: 31.58% win rate over 19 games and the packet chart reads Skill, Skill, then Quinn for every remaining stage — which is what the whys already say.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side -> Skill; win[3]/phases[3].side and win[4]/phases[4].side -> Quinn. The chart then matches the packet exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3] and phases[4] carried Lucian boilerplate ('keep the pressure rolling', 'The Culling adds lane-clear') on stages this page elsewhere calls hers.
audit.why: Behind Enemy Lines is a 3s-cooldown, 50/25/0-cost roam tool, not a duel ult — the level 6 stage is about her leaving lane, not about your ultimate.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 = Harrier kiting plus Vault on 8-12s; Level 6 = her roam.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] calls her ultimate 'Tag Team / Behind Enemy Lines'. 'Tag Team' is not the ability name.
audit.why: The ultimate is Behind Enemy Lines. Presenting a second invented name next to the real one makes both look unreliable.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are the only windows you actually own — you share her auto range, and a Q into Lightslinger double-tap can win a flat trade before her Harrier passive is rolling. Take that trade and take it early, because the second her E vault is up the lane flips: she knocks you back out of range, the vault blinds your next Lightslinger autos so your burst whiffs, and Harrier move speed lets her stroll out of every Q line you fire. Do not throw Q at her in the open — she sidesteps it on the move. Last-hit with Q's tip and hoard your E for when she actually commits.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are the only windows you actually own — you share her auto range, and a Q into Lightslinger double-tap can win a flat trade before her Harrier passive is rolling. Take that trade and take it early, because once Vault is up the lane flips: she knocks you back out of range and interrupts your string, Blinding Assault turns your next Lightslinger shots into nothing, and Harrier move speed lets her stroll out of every Q line you fire. Do not throw Q at her in the open — she sidesteps it on the move. Last-hit with Q's tip and hoard your E for when she actually commits.

edits.before: This is where it gets ugly. She kites you with Harrier speed, vaults away the moment you E in, and her constant poke chips you down faster than you can answer with no sustain. Your only real engage is baiting the E out first, then E-dashing in and W-marking her so the speed lets you stick — but if her vault is up you eat a knockback and a blind for your trouble. At 6 her R is a roam tool, not a fight button: she'll leave lane to get picks elsewhere, and your Culling channel does nothing to a champion who's already gone or who just vaulted out of it.
edits.after: This is where it gets ugly. She kites you with Harrier speed, vaults away the moment you E in, and her constant poke chips you down faster than you can answer with no sustain. Your only real engage is baiting Vault out first, then E-dashing in and W-marking her so the speed lets you stick — but with Vault up you eat a knockback and an interrupt for your trouble, and Blinding Assault erases the follow-up. At 6 her R is a roam tool, not a fight button: she leaves lane to get picks, and your Culling does nothing to a champion who already left.

notes: The blind was attributed to the wrong ability everywhere on this page, including in focus.text ('Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind)'), which propagates into winCon, enemyWin, tradeBad, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, report[1], report[3], report[5] and report[9]. focus.text itself is 24 characters and the applier skips strings under 25, so it cannot be corrected through a normal edit — the generated strings that embed it need regenerating from a corrected focus label. That is a champion-level fix outside this proposal's reach and is the single most valuable thing left undone in this matchup.
